method: OpenAI imagegen; newly drawn poses using project-created fan art

IMPORTANT all drawings fit inside their own cell with 10% empty margin on EVERY side, no overlap. No background, ground shadow, effects, words, labels, watermark. Row1: neutral, windup/anticipation, ranged release. Row2: melee release, hit reaction from right (body hunches LEFT with limbs braced, no extra attacker), recovery toward neutral. Movement must redraw jaws, limbs, knees and torso anatomically, NOT warp the entire body. Preserve all horns, armor and limb counts. Do not mirror reference designs. Ranged and melee poses details: Gabumon horned yellow reptile wearing striped wolf pelt. Closed jaw windup then blue-flame breath with open mouth aimed RIGHT. Melee foreclaw thrust, recoil folds arms.
